mapper.select: SELECT GRAPH_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY, SUBJECT_TEXT, SUBJECT_KEY, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, OBJECT_KEY, SOURCE_ID, CREATED_AT FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE DELETED=0 AND (1=0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE (GRAPH_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY, SUBJECT_TEXT, SUBJECT_KEY, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, OBJECT_KEY, SOURCE_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{graphId}, #{tenantId}, #{category}, #{subjectText}, #{subjectKey}, #{relationText}, #{objectText}, #{objectKey}, #{sourceId}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TENANT_ID=VALUES(TENANT_ID), CATEGORY=VALUES(CATEGORY), SUBJECT_TEXT=VALUES(SUBJECT_TEXT), SUBJECT_KEY=VALUES(SUBJECT_KEY), RELATION_TEXT=VALUES(RELATION_TEXT), OBJECT_TEXT=VALUES(OBJECT_TEXT), OBJECT_KEY=VALUES(OBJECT_KEY), SOURCE_ID=VALUES(SOURCE_ID), CREATED_AT=VALUES(CREATED_AT), DELETED=0
mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId}) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC

SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND CATEGORY=#{category}) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE SET DELETED=1 WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND SOURCE_ID LIKE #{sourceId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE DELETED=0

SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND (SUBJECT_KEY=#{subjectKey} OR OBJECT_KEY=#{objectKey})) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC

SELECT SUBJECT_TEXT, RELATION_TEXT, OBJECT_TEXT, SOURCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CATEGORY FROM RAG_GRAPH_TRIPLE WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND CATEGORY=#{category} AND (SUBJECT_KEY=#{subjectKey} OR OBJECT_KEY=#{objectKey})) ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, GRAPH_ID ASC
